readout_other: EMG Vpp and AUC in gastrocnemius during electrical nerve stimulation; thermocouple temperature; H&E histology
direction_notes: Lower cumulative energy (short SD, low DC) enhanced electrically evoked EMG; higher cumulative energy (long SD, high DC) suppressed it; effects persisted about 5 min.
safety_notes: Maximum temperature rise 0.34 C at 120 s and 80% DC; H&E showed no inflammation, necrosis or degeneration.

exposures.label: Sciatic nerve sonication with varied SD and DC

timing.protocol_description: Pulses of 125 cycles (tone burst duration 250 microseconds) at 500 kHz; duty cycle varied by altering the burst period; sonication duration 30, 60, 90 or 120 s delivered concurrently with 2 Hz electrical stimulation, followed by 5 min of electrical stimulation alone; 15 min break between trials.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Twenty male Sprague-Dawley rats, weighing 270–480 g, were obtained from the Animal care facility at AUB.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: received ultrasonic pulses at a frequency of 500 kHz, number of cycles (CPP) = 125, and tone burst duration (TBD) = 250 µs.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: received ultrasonic pulses at a frequency of 500 kHz, number of cycles (CPP) = 125, and tone burst duration (TBD) = 250 µs.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: The sonication duration was varied between 30, 60, 90, and 120 s. The duty cycle was varied between 30%, 50%, and 80% by altering the burst period.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: The sonication duration was varied between 30, 60, 90, and 120 s. The duty cycle was varied between 30%, 50%, and 80% by altering the burst period.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.pressure_kpa: Two intensities were considered, 1.4 W/cm² and 3.39 W/cm², with respective peak negative pressures of 0.46 MPa and 0.72 MPa.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.isppa_w_cm2: Two intensities were considered, 1.4 W/cm² and 3.39 W/cm², with respective peak negative pressures of 0.46 MPa and 0.72 MPa.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: A single-element unfocused ultrasound transducer (Mana Instruments E0525-SU)
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: A single-element unfocused ultrasound transducer (Mana Instruments E0525-SU)
